mcqs.question: In the proposed Storytelling Corridor linking Amaravati, Visakhapatnam and Tirupati, which private partners were in talks for content creation and destination promotion?
options: Red Bull and N. Chandrababu Naidu
Kandula Durgesh and N. Chandrababu Naidu
mcqs.explanation: Eros International and Red Bull were the private partners in talks for content creation and destination promotion. Kandula Durgesh and N. Chandrababu Naidu were associated with other aspects of the news, not identified as the private partners.
